title: Runtime error fingerprint & SLO triage hub
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a single-pane 'Triage Hub' that consolidates error fingerprints across transport (HTTP/gRPC), runtime (timeouts/overload), and model-level failures. The hub will use trace-hook enriched spans and an augmented logs/metrics pipeline to: 1) surface recurring fingerprints (span + error signature + model variant), 2) map them to affected SLOs and latency percentiles, and 3) provide an action-oriented triage card (suggested rollback, throttle, model fallback, or capacity increase). This ticket focuses on schema, pipeline knobs for adaptive sampling, dashboard UX tiles, and the initial canonical fingerprint catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation: tracehook adds error_signature, model_variant, and overload_tag to 95% of relevant spans
Pipeline: enriched error events ingested into telemetry datastore with retention >= 90 days
Dashboard: Triage Hub shows top 10 fingerprints by exposure and links to traces/PRs
SLO mapping: each fingerprint can be associated with one or more SLOs and shows contribution%
Playbook: triage card generates recommended remediation and links to runbook or PR template
technical_notes: We will add 3 columns to telemetry.events: error_signature (string), model_variant (string), overload_signal (enum)
Adaptive sampling: maintain a high-signal stream for new fingerprints (full traces) and store aggregated counters for long-tail fingerprints
Enrichment pipeline: Kafka topic 'trace-enriched' -> Flink job to compute fingerprint keys -> write to ClickHouse
Backfill plan: run a 7-day window job to seed initial fingerprint counts using historical traces
Cost tradeoff: full-trace retention for every error is expensive; use a TTL + cohort sampling to keep examples
Rollout: feature flag gated (telemetry.fingerprint.v1) so we can ramp per-customer and per-region
decisions: Fingerprint key heuristic: normalized span.name + normalized error.message (strip ids/timestamps) + model_layer_code
Store canonical catalog in ClickHouse (fast OLAP) and mirror summaries to BigQuery for long-term analytics
SLO mapping will be a configurable YAML in the console linked to each service route and model variant
Use existing tracehook shim (engine/tracing/hook-v2) with a small delta; avoid a full agent rewrite
open_questions: What cardinality budget do we set for model_variant labels to avoid high-cardinality blowup?
Should overload_signal be a continuous metric or coarse enum (none, mild, severe)?
Who owns the SLA mapping for cross-team services (platform or product teams)?
Do we need GDPR-specific redaction for error messages used to generate fingerprints?
